meta.name: hyperframes-keyframes
meta.description: Use when a HyperFrames composition needs a punch-in, punch-out, zoom, reframe, Ken Burns treatment, camera move, visual match/whip handoff, or other seek-safe 2D/3D keyframes; also for GSAP, CSS keyframes, Anime.js, WAAPI, FLIP, paths, masks, SVG morph/draw, text trails, 3D depth, or `hyperframes keyframes` diagnostics. Don't use for broad scene strategy, brand design, media sourcing, captions, or general video planning.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给视频添加推拉缩放、运镜和转场关键帧动画
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想给视频片段添加电影感的推拉缩放和运镜动画
copy.tagline_en: Add punch-in, zoom, reframe, and camera-move keyframes to video compositions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you edit video and want cinematic push-in, zoom, and camera-move animation

howto.what: 它让 Claude 为 HyperFrames 合成写可被安全跳转的关键帧动画，比如推拉变焦、重构图、Ken Burns 镜头，并配 GSAP、CSS、Anime.js、WAAPI 等运行时；写完还会跑校验命令并截图确认画面。
howto.when: 当你要求给 HyperFrames 合成加推拉变焦、重构图或 Ken Burns 镜头等关键帧动画，或需要排查 `hyperframes keyframes` 时触发；不做整体场景策略、品牌设计或字幕。

say.text: 给这个 HyperFrames 合成加一段从全景推到特写的推拉变焦。
say.note: 会写关键帧并用截图验证。

say.text: 把这段镜头做成带遮罩裁剪的重构图，源时间保持不动。
say.note: 用 clip-path 或遮罩做裁剪。

howto.what_en: It makes Claude author seek-safe keyframes for a HyperFrames composition — punch-ins, reframes, Ken Burns moves, masks and SVG morphs — with GSAP, CSS, Anime.js or WAAPI runtimes, then verify with lint/check commands and snapshot shots.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for punch-in, reframe or Ken Burns keyframes in a HyperFrames composition, or need `hyperframes keyframes` diagnostics. Not for scene strategy, brand design or captions.

say_en.text: Add a punch-in from wide to close-up on this HyperFrames composition.
say_en.note: Writes keyframes and verifies with shots.

say_en.text: Reframe this shot with a mask crop, leaving source time untouched.
Run hyperframes keyframes on this selector and output a strip shot.
say_en.note: Runs diagnostics and writes a shot.
